fields.name: started_at
fields.label: Started
fields.description: The workspace's first priced usage, else its first edit, else its last activity. A workspace's cost and outcome count at its start.

fields.name: outcome_label
fields.label: Outcome label
fields.description: What became of the workspace's changes, decided by the evidence tier outcome_why names. Landed and Committed need local Git evidence.

fields.name: evidence_tier
fields.label: Evidence tier
fields.description: The highest tier of evidence the workspace reached: local Git checked its commits (Tier 2), its transcript recorded tool calls (Tier 1), or neither. What a forge said of its pull requests (Tier 3) is in the Review fields and never changes the label.

fields.name: git_check
fields.label: Local Git
fields.description: Whether local Git was asked about the workspace's commits; not applicable outside a repository or for a workspace that changed nothing in one.

fields.name: git_check_reason
fields.label: Local Git reason
fields.description: Why local Git has not checked the workspace's commits, when it has not.

fields.name: project_name
fields.label: Project
fields.description: The repository, else the working folder (home as ~); empty for a workspace with no working directory (No project).

fields.name: project_kind
fields.label: Project kind
fields.description: Whether the project is a repository, a folder, or none.

fields.name: branch
fields.label: Branch
fields.description: The workspace's last recorded branch; empty outside a repository (Not a repository) and for a repository workspace that recorded none (No branch).

fields.name: provider
fields.label: Main provider
fields.description: The provider of the workspace's main model.

fields.name: model_family
fields.label: Main model
fields.description: The model that took most of the workspace's cost (most of its tokens when unpriced); empty when it recorded no usage.

fields.name: cost_usd
fields.label: Cost (API $)
fields.description: The workspace's API cost, priced as the library prices it; empty when its usage has no price or it recorded no usage (Has usage).

fields.name: tokens
fields.label: Tokens
fields.description: The workspace's reconciled tokens, the ones its cost prices.

fields.name: files_changed
fields.label: Files changed
fields.description: Files the workspace edited, from its own tool calls.

fields.name: lines_added
fields.label: Lines added
fields.description: Lines its edits added; empty when its agent app records no line counts.

fields.name: lines_removed
fields.label: Lines removed
fields.description: Lines its edits removed; empty when its agent app records no line counts.

fields.name: kept_lines
fields.label: Kept lines
fields.description: Lines it added and still had at its end, as rework judges them; empty while its rework window is open, so the rework rate never counts rework it has not had time for.

fields.name: rework_removed_lines
fields.label: Lines reworked
fields.description: Of its kept lines, those later workspaces removed within the rework window; empty while that window is open.

fields.name: kept_change
fields.label: Kept change
fields.description: 1 for a workspace whose changes were kept (Landed, Committed or Changed and kept), else 0.

fields.name: judged
fields.label: Outcome judged
fields.description: 1 for a workspace whose label judges whether its changes were kept (Landed, Committed, Changed and kept, or Reworked), else 0: Changed, too recent cannot be judged yet, and No changes and Unknown have nothing to judge. Kept share divides by it.

fields.name: judged_cost_usd
fields.label: Judged cost (API $)
fields.description: The workspace's cost when its outcome is judged, else empty: the cost that cost per kept change divides.

fields.name: kept_priced
fields.label: Priced kept change
fields.description: 1 for a kept change whose workspace has a price, else 0: what cost per kept change divides by, so an unpriced workspace counts in neither its cost nor its count.

fields.name: has_usage
fields.label: Has usage
fields.description: 1 when the workspace recorded any model usage, priced or not, else 0. A workspace without usage has no cost rather than an unpriced one.

fields.name: linked_commits
fields.label: Linked commits
fields.description: Commits local Git linked to the workspace; empty unless local Git checked it.

fields.name: landed_commits
fields.label: Commits on mainline
fields.description: Of its linked commits, those that reached mainline; empty unless local Git checked it.

fields.name: committed_lines
fields.label: Lines committed
fields.description: Lines its linked commits added, as Git counts them, whatever tool wrote them; empty unless local Git checked it.

fields.name: landed_lines
fields.label: Lines on mainline
fields.description: Of the lines its linked commits added, those in commits that reached mainline; empty unless local Git checked it.

fields.name: pull_requests
fields.label: Pull requests read
fields.description: How many of the pull requests the workspace opened or committed to were read from their forge; empty when none was, including when reading pull request reviews is off.

fields.name: pull_request_state
fields.label: Pull request
fields.description: How far the workspace's pull requests got: merged, else still open, else closed without merging. Empty when none was read.

fields.name: review_status
fields.label: Review
fields.description: The strongest verdict a reviewer other than the author gave on the workspace's pull requests: changes requested, else approved, else comments without a verdict, else not reviewed. Empty when no pull request was read.

fields.name: reviewer_kind
fields.label: Reviewed by
fields.description: Who reviewed or commented, other than the author: people, bots, both or nobody. Empty when no pull request was read.

fields.name: reviews
fields.label: Reviews
fields.description: Reviews other people or bots submitted on the pull requests the workspace opened or committed to.

fields.name: review_comments
fields.label: Review comments
fields.description: Comments other people or bots left on the pull requests the workspace opened or committed to, on lines of the change or in its conversation. The author's own comments are not counted.

fields.name: unresolved_threads
fields.label: Unresolved threads
fields.description: Comment threads on lines of the change that were not marked resolved when last read.

fields.name: commits_after_review
fields.label: Commits after first review
fields.description: Commits added to the workspace's pull requests after their first review or comment from someone else.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.label: Reviewed
fields.description: 1 when someone other than the author reviewed or commented on one of the workspace's pull requests, 0 when a pull request was read and nobody did, else empty.

fields.name: changes_requested
fields.label: Changes requested
fields.description: 1 when a reviewer requested changes on one of the workspace's pull requests, 0 when a pull request was read and none did, else empty.

fields.name: review_wait_hours
fields.label: Hours to first review
fields.description: Hours from a pull request opening to its first review or comment from someone else, summed over the workspace's reviewed pull requests.
